feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Amazon staff to strike and rally on busiest weekend of the year
articles.summary: Amazon employees around the world are set to stage protests on Black Friday amid claims of unfair pay and oppressive working conditions.

articles.title: Driver suspected of causing tanker crash in Egypt that killed 31 detained
articles.summary: The driver of a car suspected to have caused a fuel tanker to overturn in Egypt, causing the deaths of 31 people, has been detained.

articles.title: Witnesses contacted as US probe into World Cup sell-off plan intensifies
articles.summary: A planned US congressional investigation into FIFA and Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off plans is intensifying with requests to speak to current and former FIFA staff, Sky News understands.

articles.title: Airline suspends all flights - as carrier faces bankruptcy
articles.summary: Norse Atlantic Airways has suspended all flights, with the company saying it could file for bankruptcy unless an urgent solution to its finances is found.

articles.title: Myanmar says it will not comply with 'inappropriate' ICJ genocide orders
articles.summary: Myanmar's leader has said his government will not ‌comply with all measures ordered by a top international court after it was found guilty of committing genocide against the Rohingya minority.

articles.title: Major US tech index comes close to crashing into a bear market
articles.summary: A tech-heavy index on Wall Street briefly teetered into bear market territory on Wednesday - as AI-exposed stocks continue to face heavy sell-offs.

articles.title: US authorises SpaceX to deploy one million satellites to space
articles.summary: The US' Federal Communications Commission is authorising SpaceX to send a million satellites for data centres in space, the agency said.

articles.title: Two children among six dead in plane crash
articles.summary: Divers have found the bodies of six people, including two children, after a plane crashed off the coast of Mississippi on Tuesday, according to the US Coast Guard.

articles.title: Colombian police storm supermarket, freeing hostages and killing gunman
articles.summary: Colombian police have stormed a supermarket and freed at least 20 people who were being held hostage, killing one of the gunmen.
